ideas: Pension systems under pressure from longer lives
Older workers stay healthy and productive longer
Exceptions for people in physically demanding jobs

phrases.meaning: system paying money to retired people
work needing lots of body strength
a big problem or cost for

model: I believe ageing societies should raise the retirement age, although it should be phased in slowly. First, life expectancy has increased a lot, so people spend many more years in retirement than before. As a result, the pension system is put under huge pressure, and it becomes a heavy burden on younger taxpayers. Vietnam itself has been gradually raising its retirement age since 2021, largely because of an ageing population. Another reason is that many older people are still healthy and want to keep working. My uncle is sixty-two and still works as an engineer, and he's often asked to train new staff because he knows the systems better than anyone. Older workers can pass on their knowledge, which is really valuable for companies. While it's true that people in physically demanding jobs, like construction workers, may not be able to work longer, they could be given the option to retire earlier. So overall, a higher retirement age makes sense for most people.
